sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities. sources.title: Qwen 3 4B | Intel® Software Catalog
sources.snippet: Qwen3-4B strikes a strategic balance between computational efficiency and advanced reasoning capabilities. It is engineered to run seamlessly on CPU infrastructure, offering a versatile solution for general-purpose AI tasks that require more depth than micro-models without the heavy resource demands of large-scale models.
